calls.title: Glendale is parked: what would turn it back on
calls.text: Under the stopping rule you set on Oct 30, the queue parks a college once two sessions in a row each move fewer than 3% of its programs to passing. Glendale qualified: S526 and S527 each moved 5 of 226 (2.2%). It stands at 115 passing; 46 records sum to a different total than the catalog prints, and 65 still miss a course's units. Either of two things from you turns it back on. First, a structured export: ask Glendale's curriculum office for every active program's required courses with their units, as a spreadsheet from their curriculum system, and attach it in any Claude session. Second, a contact: name someone in Glendale's curriculum office who can say which printed totals are wrong, and the queue drafts the questions for you to send. Glendale's 2026-2027 catalog will restart it without you. When you have done one, write what you did in the note and press Mark done; the next scheduled session takes it first.
